title: Add AGENTS.md with Cursor Cloud development instructions
body: Adds `AGENTS.md` with development environment instructions for Cursor Cloud agents. ## What's included - Quick-reference table for common dev commands (`npm install`, `npm run dev`, `npm run lint`, `npm run build`, `npm run preview`) - Cursor Cloud specific instructions covering: - Zero-backend architecture (no external services needed) - Optional Supabase integration notes - No test suite — correctness verified via lint + build - HMR behavior - Expected build warnings - End-to-end testing workflow (Course Builder → Entry Editor) ## Evidence of working environment Demo showing: app loads at localhost:5173, course created via Course Builder, journal entry created and autosaved. ![App landing page](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-61c7778d-1f2e-47c6-9618-0d9151d88aae) ![Journal entry saved with autosave](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-1ccc4718-eee1-4820-81f1-c81cf0f47250)
